name: finish_after_second_close
description: Recording A closes at 60 s and its transcript lands at 70 s; recording B closes two minutes later, at 180 s. Finish is tapped at 185 s with nothing in progress, before B's transcript lands. Finish must finish B (the newest recording), not A's still-open window.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 (232 reads, 63 writes, 1 delete(s), 8 no-op, 0 STT, 7 LLM; caps about +10%). noop_writes=8 is the current count, not a target: every one is database/conversations_v3_leases.py:72 renew (service.reconcile run_blocking renew) rewriting the lease until at the instant it was claimed. The lab clock does not move inside one event; production's does, so this is a lab-clock repeat, reported in the PR.

expected_failure.reason: No Multica issue yet (searched 2026-11-26; nearest SCA-4385, #26288): finish_live_window prefers the newest open v3 window (A's, idle 125 s, inside live.MAX_IDLE = 2 h) over a newer sealed recording that has no window yet, so request_finish cuts at A's tail and B gets neither the cut nor a fast finish. The #26288 recording fallback runs only when no live window exists (utils/conversations/v3/finish.py:31-36).
